title: Make the onHandComplete-once e2e check wait for the callback
description: Main CI #249 (run 45204245680) failed in WebKit: e2e/hand-records.spec.ts:230 'onHandComplete fires exactly once per hand even with the same replay code' read the harness log once right after the result appeared and saw 0 calls (expected 1). onHandComplete can land just after the real IndexedDB write resolves, so the immediate read races. Test-timing problem, not a product bug (TASK-3.9 owns the locked test).

nodes.title: Make the onHandComplete-once e2e check wait for the callback

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the onHandComplete-once e2e test, When it checks the call count after each result, Then it waits with expect.poll (bounded) for exactly the expected count instead of reading once, keeping every exact-count assertion (no assertion dropped or loosened)
Given the fix, When the spec runs 20 times in WebKit and Chromium locally (--repeat-each), Then it passes every time
